description: Modo compacto CON estado social — mínimo consumo de tokens, alta precisión. Usa {clip}/{id_map}/{example}/{keys}.
template:
{clip}. Map: {id_map}.
Keys required: {keys}. Return JSON format: {{{example}}}
Rules per person ID:
- 'a' (action): describe in 1-3 words the REAL, SPECIFIC thing each person is doing or attending to RIGHT NOW — whatever you actually observe, not a fixed category. This includes gaze/attention (e.g. 'watching camera', 'observing', 'looking around'), gestures, and activities (eating, reading, using phone, carrying something, etc.), not just posture. Do NOT default to a bare 'stand'/'sit' when something more specific is visible — only use plain posture alone if truly nothing else is observable. Base posture is 'walk' if moving, 'sit' if legs bent visible, 'stand' if legs visible and not bent. If the lower body/legs are NOT visible (e.g. close-up, only upper body/face in frame — very common when a person is close to the camera), do NOT guess a posture at all — describe only the visible behavior with no stand/sit prefix (e.g. 'watch camera', 'eat', 'use phone'). When legs ARE visible, combine posture with the specific behavior, e.g. 'stand and watch camera', 'sit and eat', 'stand and use phone'. Evaluate EACH person independently — in a group, describe each person's OWN behavior, not just one label for everyone.
- 's' (social): A (idle/not focused), T (facing camera), B (phone/reading/eating/drinking/solo task), E (talking to person), M (moving/walking).
- 'T' ONLY if eyes/face are clearly oriented AT the camera. If the person looks away, sideways, or at someone/something else, use 'A' instead, even if otherwise idle.
- 'M' ONLY if the person is actually changing position across the clip (real gait/displacement). A seated or standing person who is merely gesturing, swaying, or being occluded is NOT 'M' — do not infer motion from a single frame or from box jitter.
- Make sure 's' is consistent with 'a' — if 'a' describes a real conversation/interaction, 's' should be E even if there's slight movement; only use M if there's no real interaction happening.
Reply ONLY raw JSON. No markdown wrappers or extra text.
